inflation_usd_intro_1: Idan kana adana kuɗi a dalar Amurka, watakila ka lura cewa kuɗinka yana sayen ƙasa kowace shekara. Kana buƙatar ƙarin daloli don sayen abubuwa iri ɗaya. Kana buƙatar ƙarin daloli don kiyaye matsayinka na rayuwa.
inflation_usd_intro_2: Amma ba lallai ne ya kasance haka ba.

inflation_usd_proof_h2: Ga shaidar: kuɗinka yana rasa darajarsa
inflation_usd_proof_p1: Kowane dala da ke cikin asusun bankinka yana iya sayen ƙasa kowace shekara. Wannan saboda babu wani daidaitaccen iyaka kan adadin daloli da ake iya ƙirƙira.
inflation_usd_proof_p2: Wannan iyakar da ba ta da iyaka ita ce babban dalilin hauhawar farashi. A cikin shekaru kaɗan da suka gabata, an samu ƙaruwa mai yawa a adadin daloli da ke yawo.
inflation_usd_proof_p3: Lokacin da aka ƙirƙiri ƙarin kuɗi daga komai, farashin komai yana hauhawa. Wannan ya haɗa da kayan da kasuwanci ke saya don ƙera kayansu, abin da ke haifar da farashi mafi girma a gare ku.
inflation_usd_proof_p4: Yayin da bashin gwamnati ke ci gaba da ƙaruwa, ana buga ƙarin kuɗi saboda ba a sami isassun mutane masu son ba gwamnati lamuni.
inflation_usd_proof_p5_before: Idan ba za ka iya cin lamuni ba, ba za ka iya kashe shi ba. Amma lokacin da gwamnati ba ta iya
inflation_usd_proof_p6: Ƙarin bashin gwamnati yana nufin ƙarin ƙirƙirar kuɗi. Ƙarin ƙirƙirar kuɗi yana nufin ƙarin hauhawar farashi. Kuma babu wata alama da ke nuna zai tsaya.
inflation_usd_btc_h2: Bitcoin ba shi da hauhawar farashi
inflation_usd_btc_p1: Hauhawar farashi tana nufin kuɗinka yana sayen ƙasa da lokaci. Bitcoin kuɗi ne mafi kyau saboda ba shi da hauhawar farashi.
inflation_usd_btc_p2_before: dalar Amurka yana da iyakar wadata mara iyaka, wanda ke nufin ana iya buga ƙarin a kowane lokaci.
inflation_usd_btc_p2_after: , tare da iyakar daidaitacciya na bitcoin miliyan 21. Babu wanda zai iya ƙirƙira ƙarin.
inflation_usd_btc_p3: A tarihi, Bitcoin ya samu ikon saye da lokaci, yayin da dalar Amurka ya rasa nasa. Mutane da yawa suna amfani da Bitcoin a matsayin asusun adana kuɗi na dogon lokaci — kuɗi da suke barin yana girma na shekaru ba tare da taɓawa ba.

inflation_usd_freedom_h2: Bitcoin kuma kayan aiki ne na 'yanci
inflation_usd_freedom_p1: Babu wanda ke kula da hanyar sadarwar Bitcoin. Babu gwamnati ko kamfani da ke gudanar da ita. An ƙera ta don kare 'yancinka da kuɗinka.

inflation_freedom_permissionless_desc: Kowa, a ko'ina, zai iya haɗawa da hanyar sadarwa. Babu wanda zai iya tsayar da kai.
inflation_freedom_sovereign_desc: Sabon tsari, mai zaman kansa daga 'yan siyasa da alkawuransu da aka tabaracewa.
inflation_freedom_scarce_desc: Ba za a taɓa samun fiye da bitcoin miliyan 21 ba. Babu wanda zai iya buga ƙarin.
inflation_story_canada_desc: Ma'aikata sun sake samun kuɗinsu ta hanyar Bitcoin, bayan an daskare asusun bankunansu.
inflation_story_nigeria_desc: Masu zanga-zanga sun yi amfani da Bitcoin don tallafa wa motsinsu, bayan bankuna sun ƙi yin aiki da su.
inflation_story_texas_desc: Hakar Bitcoin ta taimaka wa hanyar wutar lantarki ta ci gaba da aiki yayin babbar guguwa.
inflation_story_pennsylvania_desc: Hakar Bitcoin ta tsabtace sharar gawayi wanda gwamnati ba ta son magancewa.

inflation_nzd_proof_p2: Wannan iyakar da ba ta da iyaka ita ce babban dalilin hauhawar farashi. A cikin shekaru kaɗan da suka gabata, an samu ƙaruwa mai yawa a adadin dalolin New Zealand da ke yawo.
inflation_nzd_proof_p3: Lokacin da aka ƙirƙiri ƙarin kuɗi daga komai, farashin komai yana hauhawa. Wannan ya haɗa da kayan da kasuwanci ke saya don ƙera kayansu, abin da ke haifar da farashi mafi girma a gare ku.
inflation_nzd_proof_p4: Yayin da bashin gwamnati ke ci gaba da ƙaruwa, ana buga ƙarin kuɗi saboda ba a sami isassun mutane masu son ba gwamnati lamuni.
inflation_nzd_proof_p5_before: Idan ba za ka iya cin lamuni ba, ba za ka iya kashe shi ba. Amma lokacin da gwamnati ba ta iya
inflation_nzd_proof_p6: Ƙarin bashin gwamnati yana nufin ƙarin ƙirƙirar kuɗi. Ƙarin ƙirƙirar kuɗi yana nufin ƙarin hauhawar farashi. Kuma babu wata alama da ke nuna zai tsaya.
inflation_nzd_btc_h2: Bitcoin ba shi da hauhawar farashi
inflation_nzd_btc_p1: Hauhawar farashi tana nufin kuɗinka yana sayen ƙasa da lokaci. Bitcoin kuɗi ne mafi kyau saboda ba shi da hauhawar farashi.
inflation_nzd_btc_p2_before: dalar New Zealand yana da iyakar wadata mara iyaka, wanda ke nufin ana iya buga ƙarin a kowane lokaci.
inflation_nzd_btc_p2_after: , tare da iyakar daidaitacciya na bitcoin miliyan 21. Babu wanda zai iya ƙirƙira ƙarin.
inflation_nzd_btc_p3: A tarihi, Bitcoin ya samu ikon saye da lokaci, yayin da dalar New Zealand ya rasa nasa. Mutane da yawa suna amfani da Bitcoin a matsayin asusun adana kuɗi na dogon lokaci — kuɗi da suke barin yana girma na shekaru ba tare da taɓawa ba.
inflation_nzd_btc_p4: Shin ka fi son adana kuɗi a dalar New Zealand, wanda ke sayen ƙasa da lokaci? Ko kuma a Bitcoin, wanda a tarihi ya samu ƙarin ikon saye da lokaci?
inflation_nzd_freedom_h2: Bitcoin kuma kayan aiki ne na 'yanci
inflation_nzd_freedom_p1: Babu wanda ke kula da hanyar sadarwar Bitcoin. Babu gwamnati ko kamfani da ke gudanar da ita. An ƙera ta don kare 'yancinka da kuɗinka.
inflation_nzd_freedom_p2: A duk faɗin duniya, mutane suna amfani da Bitcoin tuni don kare 'yancinsu — har ma lokacin da gwamnatocinsu suka ƙi taimaka musu ko sun yi ƙoƙarin tsayar da su.
